verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch19.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, start years of each series, and the export, forest, under-five mortality, agricultural employment and literacy figures quoted from other World Bank series)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 2,704 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; before publishing, unverifiable phrases ('some of the biggest swings anywhere', 'more than almost anywhere in Europe') and 'why' questions the data cannot answer were removed, and a causal sentence about Irish exporters without a source was dropped

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
